title: Beyond Scaling: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Hardware Kernel Optimization via an Experience-Driven Workflow and Experience Graph Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.25570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hardware kernel optimization requires repeated compilation, correctness testing, profiling, and revision. LLM agents can automate parts of this process, and stronger foundation models, longer context windows, and longer execution horizons have improved optimization within individual tasks. These advances alone do not enable an agent to learn from completed optimization runs. Existing kernel-optimization agents seldom preserve a decision, its observed execution feedback, and the later decisions that use that evidence. Retaining every prior trajectory is also impractical because an expanding history competes with the current task for context. We present KOPE, an experience-driven framework for hardware kernel optimization. KOPE records optimization trajectories with correctness and performance feedback in Experience Graph Memory, then uses Active Context Management and Injection to retrieve relevant experience under a fixed token budget. T

translated_title: 超越扩展：通过经验驱动工作流与经验图内存实现自进化LLM代理进行硬件内核优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25570v1 公告类型：新 摘要：硬件内核优化需要反复的编译、正确性测试、性能分析和修订。LLM代理可以自动化该过程的某些部分，更强的基础模型、更长的上下文窗口和更长的执行范围改善了单个任务内的优化。但这些进展本身并不能使代理从已完成的优化运行中学习。现有的内核优化代理很少保留一个决策、其观察到的执行反馈以及后续基于该证据的决策。保留所有先前轨迹也不切实际，因为不断扩展的历史记录会与当前任务争夺上下文。我们提出KOPE，一个用于硬件内核优化的经验驱动框架。KOPE在经验图内存中记录带有正确性和性能反馈的优化轨迹，然后使用主动上下文管理和注入在固定令牌预算下检索相关经验。
tldr: KOPE通过经验图内存和主动上下文管理，使LLM代理能够从过去的硬件内核优化轨迹中学习，在固定令牌预算下实现自进化优化，克服了现有代理无法积累经验的问题。
en_tdlr: KOPE enables LLM agents to learn from past hardware kernel optimization trajectories via experience graph memory and active context management, achieving self-evolving optimization under a fixed token budget, overcoming the limitation of existing agents that cannot accumulate experience.
